The search returned Wikipedia’s [Cultural astronomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1298337464), [Institute of Astronomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=974317131), [Astronomy (disambiguation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1346230266), and [Astronomy education](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1327518763), plus [historical Britannica page 1614](https://huggingface.co/datasets/NationalLibraryOfScotland/encyclopaedia_britannica_illustrated/tree/309f765b1ecc83e0a7f7762e44b4a927a7555443).  
The historical page was mismatched—mostly “THO” entries rather than astronomy—and retrieval was partial: query and document embedding stages failed with HTTP 503, leaving lexical matching only.
